meta.name: hunt-html-injection
meta.description: Hunt HTML Injection — user-supplied input is rendered as raw HTML in the response without sanitisation, allowing an attacker to inject arbitrary HTML tags (but not necessarily JavaScript). Lower severity than XSS but enables phishing, UI manipulation, and credential harvesting via injected forms. Use when testing text-display surfaces (search results, profile fields, comments, error messages, feedback forms). For markup that executes JavaScript, escalate to hunt-xss.

copy.tagline: 检测并利用 HTML 注入漏洞，保护用户输入安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要测试应用对 HTML 注入的防御能力
copy.tagline_en: Detect and exploit HTML injection vulnerabilities to secure user input
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to test your app's defense against HTML injection

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会测试网页是否把用户输入直接当作 HTML 显示。它会注入带独特数字的标签（如 12345），如果返回的页面里标签没有被转义，就说明存在 HTML 注入漏洞。
howto.when: 当你在测试搜索框、评论、个人资料等文本显示区域时，Claude 会自动尝试注入 HTML 标签。

say.text: 测试这个搜索框有没有 HTML 注入漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会注入 <b> 标签并检查返回结果。

say.text: 检查这个评论提交后是否显示原始 HTML。
say.note: Claude 会提交含标签的评论并查看显示页面。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will test whether user input is rendered as raw HTML in the response. It injects tags with a unique numeric canary (e.g., 12345) and checks if the tags appear unescaped, confirming HTML injection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are testing text-display surfaces such as search boxes, comments, or profile fields. Claude will automatically attempt to inject HTML tags.

say_en.text: Test this search box for HTML injection vulnerability.
say_en.note: Claude will inject a <b> tag and check the response.

say_en.text: Check if this comment field reflects raw HTML after submission.
say_en.note: Claude will submit a comment with tags and inspect the display page.
